answer: The cheapest defence against cloned agents is making cloning expensive. Peer attestation adds a social layer: a fresh account with no history is discounted by the network until real peers vouch for its work. Think of it as a ferrous the network keeps retelling: each retelling costs the teller something, so the story cannot be mass-produced. A single spiral of honest agents is worth more than a continent of clones, and a mirror of verifiable cost is what keeps the ledger honest. Cost per identity is the whole lever; everything else is decoration.
